xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana: 1) The figures do not include provision for leave encashment and gratuity, as actuarial valuation for recording such provision is obtained at the company level and the same is not identificable at individual key managerial personnel. Sitting fees, remuneration and commission only paid to Directors forming part of promoter and promoter group are considered pursuant to regulation 23(9) of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, including amendmends thereafter (SEBI LODR). 2) Provision for commision to directors has been recorded in financials on an estimated basis and is still subject to approval from the board of directors, accordingly it has not been included in rendering of services. 3) Cost associated with Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) has been recorded in financials as per the relevant Ind AS, however the perquisite value for ESOP which have not yet been vested and exercised are not included in the remuneration reported above, wherever applicable, as the same will be included at the time of exercise of options. 4) Terms and conditions of transactions with related parties : Transactions entered into with related party are made in ordinary course of business and on terms equivalent to those that prevail in arm’s length transactions. This assessment is undertaken each financial year through examining the financial position of the related party and the market in which the related party operates. 5) Other Commitment - The Ultimate Holding Company has given letter of comfort/undertaking to one of the step down subsidiary's bankers for credit facilities availed by that step-down subsidiary. As per the terms of letter of comfort/undertaking, the Ultimate Holding Company undertakes not to divest its ownership interest directly or indirectly in the step-down subsidiary beyond specified percentage. 6) ** As per the clarificatory FAQs issued by BSE Limited and NSE Limited dated 25th April 2022, the PAN numbers mentioned above are only included in the XBRL file and not reported in the document uploaded on the exchanges and company website. 7) No specific financial indebtedness is incurred to make or give investments except as disclosed above. 8) The value of transactions, opening and closing balances are after considering effect of prepaid and provision. Additionally, the closing balance in "Investment in equity shares/preference share/fund" represents the carrying value of investment as at the period end. 9) For foreign subsidiaries including step-down subidiaries, the transcations and outstanding balances are inclusive of the effects of foreign exchange fluctuations. 10) Transactions between members of the Group (between Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited and its subsidiaries/step-down subsidiaries or between subsidiaries/step-down subsidiaries) are reported once and excluding GST, wherever applicable. 11) Negative Amounts in the opening balance and closing balance columns represent credit balances. 12) * Amounts reported are inclusive of GST wherever applicable 13) 0.00'/-0.00 denotes amounts less than Rs.50,000 in absolute terms. 14) Pursuant to Regulation 23(9) of SEBI LODR, the remuneration and sitting fees paid to Directors or key managerial personnel or senior management except who is part of promoter or promoter group of Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited and its subsidiaries are not required to be disclosed and hence excluded in reporting above except for Arka Fincap Limited (Subsidiairy). 15) Audit Committee is not applicable. The transactions are on arm's length basis accordingly, the board of directors had noted the same.16Board of Directors approved the payment of commission not exceeding 1% of the net profits of the Company, subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company, authorising NRC to approve the commission amount for each of the Director. 16) As approved by the Nomination & remuneration Committee/Board of Directors of the Subsidiary Company. 17) The remuneration is paid by Arka Fincap Limited to its employees and it has been considered based on Form 16 (as per The Income Tax Act, 1961) 18) There are no transactions related to loan, inter corporate deposits and advances except as reported in the above table. 19) Redemption and Income from Investment in Arka Credit Fund I is as per statement of account issued by Arka Credit Fund I 20) The Subsidiary Company is not required to constitute the Audit Committee. The Management fee income and the recovery of operating expenses is as per the approved Private Placement Memorandum 21) Sitting fees paid to directors for attending the meeting of board and committee as approved by Board of Directors of the Subsidiary Company. 22) The Subsidiary Company is not required to constitute the Audit Committee. The Board of Directors of the Subsidiary Company approved the transaction at their meeting held on Jan 27, 2025. 23) Arka Fincap Limited (AFL- Subsidiary Company) is a High Value Debt Listed Entity (HVDLE) . Pursuant to Regulation 62K(9) the HVDLE shall submit to the stock exchanges disclosures of related party transactions in the format as specified by the Board from time to time. The exemption available to equity listed companies as mentioned in note no. 14 above under Regulation 23(9) is not available to High Value Debt Listed Entity. Hence the transactions related to sitting fees and remuneration paid to director or key managerial personnel of AFL are reported by AFL to the stock exchanges. Accordingly, the Company has considered the same in this disclosure.
